title: Sinusoid
text: 对直流偏移和正弦调制建模；按 {Sinusoidal amplitude in-phase} 指定同相幅度；{Source type} 指定波类型 Ideal、{Offset in-phase} 指定同相偏移、{Offset quadrature} 指定正交偏移、{Sinusoidal amplitude quadrature} 指定正交幅度、{Sinusoidal modulation frequency} 指定调制频率、{Time delay} 指定调制时间延迟、{Carrier frequencies} 指定载波频率、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地，按实例取值。

params.name: Source type
params.values: 波类型 Ideal voltage (default) | Ideal current

params.name: Offset in-phase
params.values: 同相偏移 0 V (default) | 0 A | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Offset quadrature
params.values: 正交偏移 0 V (default) | 0 A | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal amplitude in-phase
params.values: 同相幅度 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal amplitude quadrature
params.values: 正交幅度 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal modulation frequency
params.values: 调制频率 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Time delay
params.values: 调制时间延迟 0 (default) | vector of real | s | ms | us | ns

params.name: Carrier frequencies
params.values: 载波频率 0 (default) | vector of real positive numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off
